author: Lindsey Winhoffer
title: Apple (AAPL) Price Target Cut to $245.00
text:
Tweet
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its target price trimmed by DA Davidson to $245.00 in a research report report published on Wednesday morning, The Fly reports. The firm currently has a buy rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. DA Davidson also issued estimates for Apple’s Q2 2019 earnings at $2.14 EPS, Q3 2019 earnings at $1.74 EPS, Q4 2019 earnings at $2.31 EPS, FY2019 earnings at $10.39 EPS, FY2020 earnings at $11.02 EPS, FY2021 earnings at $11.73 EPS, FY2022 earnings at $12.49 EPS and FY2023 earnings at $13.35 EPS. The analysts noted that the move was a valuation call.
A number of other analysts also recently commented on AAPL. Royal Bank of Canada upped their target price on Apple to $250.00 and gave the stock an average rating in a research note on Wednesday, September 26th. Cleveland Research reiterated a buy rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 26th. Morgan Stanley reiterated a buy rating and set a $247.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 26th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. started coverage on Apple in a research report on Thursday, September 27th. They set an overweight rating and a $272.00 price target on the stock. Finally, Macquarie reiterated a buy rating and set a $235.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Thursday, September 27th. Three research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company. Apple has an average rating of Hold and an average target price of $195.33. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of AAPL traded down $1.58 during mid-day trading on Wednesday, reaching $152.34. The company had a trading volume of 17,921,478 shares, compared to its average volume of 38,262,212. Apple has a 52-week low of $142.00 and a 52-week high of $233.47. The company has a quick ratio of 1.09, a current ratio of 1.12 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. The company has a market capitalization of $753.49 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 12.79, a PEG ratio of 1.48 and a beta of 1.23. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The firm had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the business earned $2.07 earnings per share. The company’s revenue was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. As a group, equities analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.89 EPS for the current fiscal year.
In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website . 0.05% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders.

About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
